text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer! Look over there! 
There's a health spa center!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if this opened recently. Why 
don't we stop by for a bit!"
choice_data_list:
Looks like this'll be a nice change of 
pace.

This seems like it'll be a nice change of 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty particular about my health, you 
know? If someone like me were to go to a 
wellness center...
choice_data_list: いい気分転換になりそうだな
いい気分転換になりそうだね
choice_data_list_en: Looks like this will be a good change of pace.
Looks like this will be a good change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... Might I turn into an 
ultra-super healthy child?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~! A jacuzzi~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The bubbling and foaming is so amazing~!
choice_data_list: The water temperature is perfect, too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, they even have an electric bath?! 
Ugh... This is going to be a real test of 
courage!
choice_data_list_en: The bath temperature is exquisite too!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Abababababa! Th-This kind of thrill is 
weirdly addictive in its own way!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp, gulp, gulp!*

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Puh-haaaah*! It really soaks into a 
heated-up body~. Nothing beats this after 
a bath, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I managed to chug it down! I usually choke 
on drinks. Is this the power of the 
wellness center...!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a massage chair! Alright then, I'm 
gonna get super healthy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoa~n, whoa~n. That hits the spot—!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Talk about the royal treatment~. So 
paradise was in a place like this all 
along?"
choice_data_list:
Ahhh, all the fatigue is just blowing 
away~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Next, how about we get fancy with some hot 
spring ping-pong!
choice_data_list_en: Aah, all my fatigue is blowing away~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! I'll show you what I've got at 
full power! Let's, ping-pong!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Working up a healthy sweat, 
feeling healthily refreshed...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The health center... is the best... It's 
so relaxing... I feel like I'm melting 
away~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm so glad we came!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's smile as she 
enjoys herself to the fullest, I can't 
help but truly feel that way.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I'm so glad we came!
Yeah, I'm so glad we came!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yeees... Seriously, like I'm melting 
away... Melt... meeelt......

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...So limp and squishy~~~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quietly cooled off together with 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi in the common hall.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Waaah, I can't put any strength into it~~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I took health so far that I ended up being 
unhealthy instead, haha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy seeing her enjoy herself in 
good health that I completely forgot to 
stop her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, no, there's no need to apologize 
like that~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know collapsing was my fault, but I'm 
completely satisfied today! Because—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If you give your all to doing fun things, 
you can smile brightly tomorrow too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That the me of yesterday gave it her all. 
That I lived today without any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even if you fall, you can just laugh it 
off later!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean, having nothing happen is 
definitely for the best, though!
choice_data_list: That's good for mental health, for sure.

That's really good for mental health, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean, having nothing happen is 
definitely for the best, though!
choice_data_list_en: That's truly good for the soul.
That's truly good for the soul.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ooh~!! Trainer, well said!
choice_data_list_en: That's truly good for the soul.
That's truly good for the soul.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Physical health comes from mental 
health...! I'll show you I can get right 
back in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's gentle smile, 
I felt like I was the one receiving energy 
from her.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, next time I'll train my body even 
more, to the point where I definitely 
won't collapse!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but that doesn't change the fact that 
I'm going to enjoy it with all my might!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
We're going to push our limits even 
further!
